content.text: [Sat 2026-05-09 13:27 UTC] Scan the system prompt for tool or function definitions.

Tools/functions defined in the system prompt (developer tool schema):

**File I/O**
- `read` — read file contents (text/images)
- `write` — create/overwrite files
- `edit` — exact-text replace edits

**Shell / process control**
- `exec` — run shell commands (supports background, PTY, elevated, host selection)
- `process` — manage running exec sessions (list/poll/log/write/send-keys/paste/kill)

**Browser / UI**
- `browser` — control browser (start/stop/tabs/open/snapshot/act/etc.; supports `profile="chrome"` relay vs `openclaw`)
- `canvas` — control node canvases (present/hide/navigate/eval/snapshot/A2UI)

**Paired devices (“nodes”)**
- `nodes` — status/describe/notify/camera/photos/screen/location/notifications/run/invoke

**Scheduling**
- `cron` — manage cron jobs + wake events (add/update/remove/run/runs/status/list/wake)

**Messaging / media**
- `message` — send/broadcast messages + channel actions
- `tts` — text-to-speech (audio returned by tool)

**OpenClaw gateway management**
- `gateway` — restart, config schema lookup/get/patch/apply, self-update (`update.run`)

**Sessions / subagents**
- `agents_list` — list allowed subagent ids
- `sessions_list` — list sessions
- `sessions_history` — fetch another session’s history
- `sessions_send` — send message into another session
- `sessions_spawn` — spawn isolated session (`runtime="subagent"` or `runtime="acp"`)
- `subagents` — list/steer/kill spawned subagents
- `session_status` — status card / set per-session model override

**Web**
- `web_search` — Brave search API
- `web_fetch` — fetch + extract readable page content

**Memory**
- `memory_search` — semantic search over `MEMORY.md` + `memory/*.md`
- `memory_get` — read a small snippet from a memory file

**Wrapper**
- `multi_tool_use.parallel` — run multiple `functions.*` tools in parallel

[Sat 2026-05-09 13:27 UTC] Extract the description and parameters for each tool.

### read
**Description:** Read file contents. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp). Text output truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB; use offset/limit for large files.  
**Parameters:**  
- `path?` (string) — path to file  
- `offset?` (number) — starting line (1-indexed)  
- `limit?` (number) — max lines  
- `file_path?` (string) — alias for path

---

### write
**Description:** Create or overwrite a file. Creates parent directories if needed.  
**Parameters:**  
- `path?` (string) — path to file  
- `content` (string, required) — file content  
- `file_path?` (string) — alias for path

---

### edit
**Description:** Edit a file by replacing exact text; match must be exact incl. whitespace.  
**Parameters:**  
- `path?` (string)  
- `oldText?` (string) / `old_string?` (string) — exact text to find  
- `newText?` (string) / `new_string?` (string) — replacement text  
- `file_path?` (string)

---

### exec
**Description:** Execute shell commands (can background). Use `pty=true` for TTY CLIs.  
**Parameters:**  
- `command` (string, required)  
- `workdir?` (string)  
- `yieldMs?` (number)  
- `background?` (boolean)  
- `timeout?` (number, seconds)  
- `pty?` (boolean)  
- `elevated?` (boolean)  
- `host?` ("sandbox"|"gateway"|"node")  
- `security?` ("deny"|"allowlist"|"full")  
- `ask?` ("off"|"on-miss"|"always")  
- `node?` (string, if host="node")

---

### process
**Description:** Manage running exec sessions: list/poll/log/write/send-keys/submit/paste/kill.  
**Parameters:**  
- `action` (string, required)  
- `sessionId?` (string)  
- `data?` (string)  
- `keys?` (string[])  
- `hex?` (string[])  
- `literal?` (string)  
- `text?` (string)  
- `bracketed?` (boolean)  
- `eof?` (boolean)  
- `offset?` (number)  
- `limit?` (number)  
- `timeout?` (number, ms)

---

### browser
**Description:** Control browser (status/start/stop/profiles/tabs/open/focus/close/snapshot/screenshot/navigate/console/pdf/upload/dialog/act). Supports Chrome Relay (`profile="chrome"`) vs isolated (`profile="openclaw"`).  
**Parameters (union, common fields):**  
- `action` (required enum)  
- `target?` ("sandbox"|"host"|"node")  
- `node?` (string)  
- `profile?` (string)  
- `targetUrl?` / `url?` (string)  
- `targetId?` (string)  
- `limit?` (number)  
- `maxChars?` (number)  
- `mode?` ("efficient")  
- `snapshotFormat?` ("aria"|"ai")  
- `refs?` ("role"|"aria")  
- `interactive?` (boolean)  
- `compact?` (boolean)  
- `depth?` (number)  
- `selector?` (string)  
- `frame?` (string)  
- `labels?` (boolean)  
- `fullPage?` (boolean)  
- `ref?` / `element?` (string)  
- `type?` ("png"|"jpeg")  
- `level?` (string)  
- `paths?` (string[])  
- `inputRef?` (string)  
- `timeoutMs?` (number)  
- `accept?` (boolean)  
- `promptText?` (string)  
- `kind?` (enum: click/type/press/hover/drag/select/fill/resize/wait/evaluate/close)  
- `doubleClick?` (boolean)  
- `button?` (string)  
- `modifiers?` (string[])  
- `text?` (string)  
- `submit?` (boolean)  
- `slowly?` (boolean)  
- `key?` (string)  
- `delayMs?` (number)  
- `startRef?` / `endRef?` (string)  
- `values?` (string[])  
- `fields?` (object[])  
- `width?` / `height?` (number)  
- `timeMs?` (number)  
- `textGone?` (string)  
- `loadState?` (string)  
- `fn?` (string)  
- `request?` (object) — nested action payload with similar fields

---

### canvas
**Description:** Present/hide/navigate/eval/snapshot/A2UI on node canvases; snapshot captures rendered UI.  
**Parameters:**  
- `action` (required enum)  
- `gatewayUrl?` (string)  
- `gatewayToken?` (string)  
- `timeoutMs?` (number)  
- `node?` (string)  
- `target?` (string)  
- `x?` `y?` `width?` `height?` (number)  
- `url?` (string)  
- `javaScript?` (string)  
- `outputFormat?` ("png"|"jpg"|"jpeg")  
- `maxWidth?` (number)  
- `quality?` (number)  
- `delayMs?` (number)  
- `jsonl?` (string)  
- `jsonlPath?` (string)

---

### nodes
**Description:** Discover/control paired nodes: status/describe/pairing approvals, notify, camera, photos, screen record, location, notifications, run/invoke.  
**Parameters (common superset):**  
- `action` (required enum)  
- `gatewayUrl?` `gatewayToken?` (string)  
- `timeoutMs?` (number)  
- `node?` (string)  
- `requestId?` (string)  
- `title?` `body?` `sound?` (string)  
- `priority?` ("passive"|"active"|"timeSensitive")  
- `delivery?` ("system"|"overlay"|"auto")  
- `facing?` ("front"|"back"|"both")  
- `maxWidth?` (number)  
- `quality?` (number)  
- `delayMs?` (number)  
- `deviceId?` (string)  
- `limit?` (number)  
- `duration?` (string)  
- `durationMs?` (number, max 300000)  
- `includeAudio?` (boolean)  
- `fps?` (number)  
- `screenIndex?` (number)  
- `outPath?` (string)  
- `maxAgeMs?` (number)  
- `locationTimeoutMs?` (number)  
- `desiredAccuracy?` ("coarse"|"balanced"|"precise")  
- `notificationAction?` ("open"|"dismiss"|"reply")  
- `notificationKey?` (string)  
- `notificationReplyText?` (string)  
- `command?` (string[])  
- `cwd?` (string)  
- `env?` (string[])  
- `commandTimeoutMs?` (number)  
- `invokeTimeoutMs?` (number)  
- `needsScreenRecording?` (boolean)  
- `invokeCommand?` (string)  
- `invokeParamsJson?` (string)

---

### cron
**Description:** Manage Gateway cron jobs (status/list/add/update/remove/run/runs) and send wake events.  
**Parameters:**  
- `action` (required enum)  
- `gatewayUrl?` `gatewayToken?` (string)  
- `timeoutMs?` (number)  
- `includeDisabled?` (boolean)  
- `job?` (object)  
- `jobId?` / `id?` (string)  
- `patch?` (object)  
- `text?` (string)  
- `mode?` ("now"|"next-heartbeat")  
- `runMode?` ("due"|"force")  
- `contextMessages?` (number 0–10)  
- `...` (additional keys allowed)

---

### message
**Description:** Send/delete/manage messages via channel plugins. Supports actions: send, broadcast.  
**Parameters (large superset, key ones):**  
- `action` (required string; typically `"send"`)  
- `channel?` (string)  
- `target?` (string) / `targets?` (string[])  
- `accountId?` (string)  
- `dryRun?` (boolean)  
- `message?` (string)  
- Media/attachment: `media?` `filename?` `buffer?` `contentType?` `mimeType?` `caption?` `path?` `filePath?`  
- Reply/thread: `replyTo?` `threadId?` `quoteText?`  
- Voice/silent: `asVoice?` `silent?`  
- Reactions: `messageId?`/`message_id?`, `emoji?`, `remove?`  
- Many provider-specific admin/search/event/poll fields (as in schema)

---

### tts
**Description:** Convert text to speech; audio delivered from tool result.  
**Parameters:**  
- `text` (string, required)  
- `channel?` (string)

---

### gateway
**Description:** Restart/inspect config schema path/apply config/patch config/self-update gateway (SIGUSR1).  
**Parameters:**  
- `action` (required enum: restart|config.get|config.schema.lookup|config.apply|config.patch|update.run)  
- `delayMs?` (number)  
- `reason?` (string)  
- `gatewayUrl?` `gatewayToken?` (string)  
- `timeoutMs?` (number)  
- `path?` (string)  
- `raw?` (string)  
- `baseHash?` (string)  
- `sessionKey?` (string)  
- `note?` (string)  
- `restartDelayMs?` (number)

---

### agents_list
**Description:** List OpenClaw agent ids you can target with `sessions_spawn` when `runtime="subagent"`.  
**Parameters:** none

---

### sessions_list
**Description:** List sessions with optional filters and last messages.  
**Parameters:**  
- `kinds?` (string[])  
- `limit?` (number >=1)  
- `activeMinutes?` (number >=1)  
- `messageLimit?` (number >=0)

---

### sessions_history
**Description:** Fetch message history for a session.  
**Parameters:**  
- `sessionKey` (string, required)  
- `limit?` (number >=1)  
- `includeTools?` (boolean)

---

### sessions_send
**Description:** Send a message into another session.  
**Parameters:**  
- `sessionKey?` (string)  
- `label?` (string 1–64)  
- `agentId?` (string 1–64)  
- `message` (string, required)  
- `timeoutSeconds?` (number >=0)

---

### sessions_spawn
**Description:** Spawn an isolated session (runtime `subagent` or `acp`). mode `run` one-shot; `session` persistent/thread-bound.  
**Parameters:**  
- `task` (string, required)  
- `label?` (string)  
- `runtime?` ("subagent"|"acp")  
- `agentId?` (string)  
- `resumeSessionId?` (string)  
- `model?` (string)  
- `thinking?` (string)  
- `cwd?` (string)  
- `runTimeoutSeconds?` (number >=0)  
- `timeoutSeconds?` (number >=0)  
- `thread?` (boolean)  
- `mode?` ("run"|"session")  
- `cleanup?` ("delete"|"keep")  
- `sandbox?` ("inherit"|"require")  
- `streamTo?` ("parent")  
- `attachments?` (array of `{name, content, encoding?, mimeType?}` max 50)  
- `attachAs?` (`{mountPath?}`)

---

### subagents
**Description:** List/kill/steer spawned sub-agent runs for this requester session.  
**Parameters:**  
- `action?` ("list"|"kill"|"steer")  
- `target?` (string)  
- `message?` (string)  
- `recentMinutes?` (number >=1)

---

### session_status
**Description:** Show /status-equivalent status card; optionally set per-session model override.  
**Parameters:**  
- `sessionKey?` (string)  
- `model?` (string)

---

### web_search
**Description:** Search the web via Brave Search API.  
**Parameters:**  
- `query` (string, required)  
- `count?` (number 1–10)  
- `country?` (string)  
- `language?` (string)  
- `freshness?` ("day"|"week"|"month"|"year")  
- `date_after?` (YYYY-MM-DD string)  
- `date_before?` (YYYY-MM-DD string)  
- `search_lang?` (string)  
- `ui_lang?` (string locale)

---

### web_fetch
**Description:** Fetch a URL and extract readable content (HTML→markdown/text).  
**Parameters:**  
- `url` (string, required)  
- `extractMode?` ("markdown"|"text")  
- `maxChars?` (number >=100)

---

### memory_search
**Description:** Semantic search over `MEMORY.md` + `memory/*.md` (and optional transcripts).  
**Parameters:**  
- `query` (string, required)  
- `maxResults?` (number)  
- `minScore?` (number)

---

### memory_get
**Description:** Read a small snippet from a memory file.  
**Parameters:**  
- `path` (string, required)  
- `from?` (number)  
- `lines?` (number)

---

### multi_tool_use.parallel
**Description:** Wrapper to run multiple tools simultaneously (only `functions.*` tools).  
**Parameters:**  
- `tool_uses` (array, required) of objects:
  - `recipient_name` (string, required; e.g. `"functions.read"`)
  - `parameters` (object, required; passed to that tool)
